capabilities: insert images at the cursor via a configurable hotkey
copy images outside the vault into a configurable asset folder
generate alt text from templates with filename variables
choose relative or absolute image paths
add custom file extensions beyond the built-in image formats
extras: README is written in both English and Chinese; notes that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; includes developer build/install instructions (Node.js 18+, Obsidian >= 1.5.0).
problem: Inserting an image into a note takes several manual steps (pasting or copying the file into the vault and writing the Markdown link by hand); the plugin reduces it to one hotkey.
summary: Hotkey-driven image inserter that opens a file picker, copies external images into the vault, and inserts Markdown image syntax at the cursor.
